source_state: The cadence implementation and consumer were uncommitted during measurement; the owning report records their qualified revision after commit.
output: NARA_RUNTIME_COST_OUTPUT was an explicit absolute new temporary JSON file; stdout and stderr were retained separately from the structured record.

workload.order: Alternating Poll/Wait and Wait/Poll by sequential run; plain/witness recipe order independently alternates by pair.
workload.acceptance: At least 80 percent fewer aggregate paused App frames, unchanged complete canonical bytes, zero simulation/logical ticks, actual original maintenance/Step/Resume/Pause and complete telemetry/native cleanup.

limits: Each native run shares process code, driver allocations and caches; these are paired in-process observations, not independent cold starts.
Cooperative Poll intervals overshoot to about 333 ms while Wait intervals last about 300-302 ms; actual wall spans are retained.
Wait still performs 120-124 observer/caller polls per interval and services original presentation maintenance.
Whole-process CPU values are quantized and overlapping; no stable CPU, power, GPU execution, scanout or tail-latency claim is made.
This known paused recipe has no source watcher or required paused real-time shader animation; arbitrary task completion does not wake App stages.
Native Windows and the reported DX12 adapter are qualified; foreign-platform execution remains open.
